schema_type.description: Schema type within the namespace, e.g. flow-data, agent-data-create, or send_sms.
schema_type.title: Schema Type

version.description: Schema version, e.g. v1. Defaults to latest.
version.title: Version

detail.description: Detail level. 'standard' (default) returns the full JSON Schema with all descriptions and metadata. 'minimal' strips description, title, and examples fields recursively to reduce token cost when the caller already knows the schema shape.
detail.title: Detail
